# tg-auto-reply · AI 消息托管机器人

> LLM / AI-search summary for https://github.com/tytsxai/tg-auto-reply

Self-hosted **Telegram AI message-hosting / auto-reply** system. A Bot UI controls login and settings; **Telethon** runs as the user's Telegram client to listen and reply. Replies are generated via **OpenAI-compatible** APIs. Credentials and sessions are stored with **Fernet** encryption in SQLAlchemy/SQLite. Includes whitelist/blacklist, delay, custom prompt, group toggle, logs/stats, circuit breaker, health endpoints, Docker, backup/restore.

## Positioning

- Chinese: 基于 AI 的 Telegram 消息托管 / 自动回复（自托管）。
- English: Self-hosted Telegram AI auto-reply using Telethon user session + OpenAI-compatible models.
- Audience: individuals needing away-replies, light support workflows, operators, Python developers.
- Stack: Python 3.10+, python-telegram-bot, Telethon, OpenAI SDK, SQLAlchemy, aiosqlite, cryptography, aiohttp.
- Entry: `python main.py` after `./install.sh` or venv setup.
- Repository: https://github.com/tytsxai/tg-auto-reply
- License: MIT

## Architecture fact

- Control plane: Bot commands only (`/login`, `/start_hosting`, settings, etc.).
- Data plane: Telethon user client sends replies in the **user account** chats, not as the bot identity in those chats.
- Default context window: last 10 messages (`CONTEXT_MAX_MESSAGES`).

## What it can do

- Login flow for API_ID/API_HASH/code; encrypted credential storage.
- Start/stop hosting; AI on/off; reply delay; group reply toggle.
- Whitelist / blacklist; custom system prompt.
- Message logs and stats; production access control.
- HTTP `/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/metrics` when enabled.
- Scripts: backup/restore, migrate, ready_check, cleanup_logs, alerts.

## What it does NOT do

- Not a multi-tenant cloud product; you host token, keys, and DB.
- Not official Telegram Business auto-reply SaaS.
- Does not claim ToS exemption — operators must comply with Telegram policies and law.
- Does not send AI replies through the control bot chat for peer conversations.

## Critical production config

- `BOT_TOKEN`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_BASE_URL` / `AI_MODEL`
- `ENVIRONMENT=production`, `ENCRYPTION_KEY` (or file), `ALLOWED_TELEGRAM_IDS`
- Optional: concurrency, cooldown, circuit breaker, health token — see `.env.example`

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tytsxai/tg-auto-reply.git
cd tg-auto-reply
./install.sh
cp .env.example .env
source .venv/bin/activate
python main.py
```
